She values LGBTQ+ acceptance, mentors trans youth, hopes to counsel trans people, build a children’s library, and adopt. Favorite book: *Becoming Nicole*; favorite color: blue. Sunflowers mean warmth/happiness, roses love/beauty. Her grandmother’s Swedish cross-heart necklace symbolizes love, faith, strength and family roots. A friend gave her a painted bowl for her 18th birthday in 2013.

Melanie was married five years by 2023. Family, creativity and nature bring her peace; she enjoys camping, hiking, running, violin, reading, pottery and painting. Dog Luna; cats Oliver and Bailey joined 23 Aug 2023. Her children made her a dog-face cup and sunset/palm painting (15 Jul 2023). She cherishes Perseid wishes (2022), her youngest child’s first steps and beach sunsets. Caroline’s guinea pig Oscar likes parsley; childhood horseback rides with her father were special.

Jul–Sep 2023: Caroline joined Connected LGBTQ Activists, applied to adoption agencies, mentored a trans teen and volunteered at an LGBTQ youth center. Her art explores transition, identity and acceptance; she plays acoustic guitar and likes “Brave” by Sara Bareilles. Melanie camped with her kids and volunteered at a homeless shelter. A September injury paused pottery; she read Caroline’s recommendation and painted. They shared sunset and abstract paintings; blue streaks represented tranquility. Caroline tried abstract art and attended a transgender poetry reading.

13 Oct 2023: Caroline contacted an adoption mentor. Melanie was considering adoption; Caroline suggested researching agencies/lawyers, gathering documents/references and preparing emotionally. 20 Oct: Melanie’s son was in a car accident on a road trip but was okay; family was frightened, then reassured the other children. Grand Canyon visit delighted them.

rebuild.19:
Caroline is a transgender woman from Sweden; she moved from her home country around 2019 and has been transitioning since about 2020. Friends, family, and mentors supported her, especially through a difficult breakup. She values LGBTQ community, authenticity, advocacy, art, and helping others. She mentors trans youth, volunteers at an LGBTQ+ youth center, and joined Connected LGBTQ Activists on July 18, 2023. She uses painting, drawing, guitar (since about 2018), and books to express herself; favorite book is *Becoming Nicole* by Amy Ellis Nutt. She hopes to work in counseling/mental health.

Caroline has long wanted to adopt and provide children a safe, loving home. She researched inclusive agencies, applied in August 2023, and passed agency interviews on October 20, 2023. She plans to become a single parent and has been building a children’s library. Her grandmother in Sweden gave her a meaningful cross-and-heart necklace; a friend gave her a painted bowl for her 18th birthday.

Melanie is married (about 2018) with children; family is her main support and motivation. She enjoys camping, hiking, beach trips, music, running, reading, painting, and pottery. She has pets named Luna, Oliver, and Bailey (which names belong to which pets is unclear). In September 2023 she injured herself and paused pottery. On October 14–15, 2023, her son had an accident on a family road trip; he was okay. They visited the Grand Canyon. Melanie and Caroline are close, supportive friends.
